hints.text: Long division goes one place at a time, starting with the biggest place. Begin by asking how many nines fit in the hundreds.
$9 \times 400 = 3600$, so take $3600$ away from $4329$. Then divide the $729$ that remains by $9$ in the same way.
$729 = 720 + 9$, which is $80$ nines and $1$ nine, so the quotient is $400 + 80 + 1 = 481$.

explanation: Start with the hundreds: $9 \times 400 = 3600$ fits, and it leaves $4329 - 3600 = 729$.
Move to the tens: $9 \times 80 = 720$ fits in $729$, and it leaves $729 - 720 = 9$.
The last $9$ is exactly one more nine, so nothing is left over.
Add up the nines you took out: $400 + 80 + 1 = 481$, so $4{,}329 \div 9 = 481$.
